questions.q: A sector has radius 6 cm and angle 60°. Find the arc length in terms of π.
questions.why: Arc = 60/360 × 2π × 6 = 2π cm (6π cm² is the sector area).

questions.q: A cone has radius 3 cm and perpendicular height 4 cm. Find its volume in terms of π.
questions.why: V = ⅓πr²h = ⅓ × π × 9 × 4 = 12π (15π is the curved surface area).
